production_provider_contract_and_allowli.notes: Accept the Google Cloud Data Processing Addendum (processor terms; no training on customer data) in the Cloud console, enable only the Cloud Vision API, restrict the API key to that API, keep HEALTH_AI_API_URL on the EU endpoint (eu-vision.googleapis.com) with HEALTH_AI_ALLOWED_HOSTS_JSON limited to that exact host, set a billing budget alert and the 900-unit monthly guard, rotate the key, and record the Turkish KVKK standard-contract transfer notification where the transfer rules require it. See docs/HEALTH_AI_PROVIDER_REVIEW_2026-10-05.md.

schedule_rules_review_and_ocr_language_c.notes: Review the schedule constants in supabase/functions/_shared/healthBookletCheck.ts (vaccination and parasite-treatment intervals) against the current published guidance named in the document check notice, and measure the OCR plus rules on labelled booklet photos in each supported language. Unsupported species, languages, layouts or handwriting must route to a person, never to approval.

confidence_calibration_and_false_decisio.notes: Validate the >0.85 auto / 0.65-0.85 manual / <0.65 reject policy on representative labelled documents and record false-accept/false-reject rates before production enablement.

manual_review_staffing_under_24h.notes: Verify staffed operational coverage, queue alerts, escalation and measured review SLA under 24 hours.

production_privacy_and_deletion_exercise.notes: Exercise provider-side deletion/retention and Tailmance account deletion/export using synthetic health documents; confirm raw OCR/provider content is not written to Tailmance telemetry.
